worldcombat.skill.horndrill.summary: Crouch, spin the horn into a drill and bore out along a straight line: the first living thing in the path is run through and finished in one blow. It is the only member that moves: step off the line, or stand behind a wall, and the drill can only bury itself in the ground.
Drill %1$s blocks with a %2$s-block contact radius. Stop at the first enemy actually touched and attempt one execution hit. Native immunity and damage rules still apply.

There are %1$s s of spin-up between locking the path and the charge; every level the user has over the target shortens it and being out-levelled lengthens it, and the target must leave the line in that time.
Charge speed %1$s blocks/tick; a wall, the end of the run or a target contact stops the charge.
worldcombat.skill.horndrill.wide.on: Wide form: drill radius x1.35, but a shorter charge, slower spin-up and longer recovery - slower and easier to dodge, yet clipping the edge still catches.
worldcombat.skill.horndrill.wide.off: Narrow form: longer and faster with a shorter recovery, but a hair off centre slips past.
worldcombat.skill.horndrill.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s from commit.
worldcombat.skill.horndrill.growth.0: From level %1$s the charge reaches %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.horndrill.growth.1: From level %1$s the charge reaches %2$s blocks, the drill radius %3$s blocks and the spin-up shortens to %4$s s.
worldcombat.skill.horndrill.use.0: Run a target through along a close-range line
worldcombat.skill.horndrill.use.1: Force a foe to step aside, or stop dead against a wall
worldcombat.skill.horndrill.use.2: Finish a stationary target with one bore
worldcombat.skill.horndrill.preference.w: On: drill radius x1.35 at the cost of a x0.85 charge, +6 ticks of spin-up and +4 ticks of recovery - slower and easier to dodge, yet clipping the edge still catches. Off (narrow form): longer, faster and quicker to recover, but a hair off centre slips past.
worldcombat.skill.horndrill.preference.a: The companion only considers horn drill while the threat is within this distance; smaller keeps it to close range, larger commits into the charge from further away.
Below this health ratio the companion stops spending an instant kill on the target; higher keeps it for healthy foes only.
